replies.author: rinn
replies.body:
Hello,

You have several previous infractions for profanity and disrespect. I've recently checked your chat logs, and it appears that you constantly swear and are rude to other players. Racism is also not acceptable on our platforms because it is offensive to other players, and often causes several disputes and arguments. Your punishment is therefore verified, making your appeal denied.

Regards,
Rinn
